title: Everything running, on one Lock Screen card
summary: Your iPhone shows everything Trillion is doing on one Lock Screen card you page through, and you can add Trillion widgets that show what you pick.

payload.title: One card for all your work
payload.body: Copies, exports and anything else running now share one card on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Tap Next to see the next one.

payload.title: It never sits frozen
payload.body: When work stops reporting, the card says when it last heard from it. When nothing is running, the card goes away by itself.

payload.title: Pick what your widgets show
payload.body: Press and hold your Home Screen or Lock Screen, add the Trillion widget, then press and hold it to pick what it shows: running work, what Trillion told you, your pursuits, decisions waiting or work for your AIs. It wears the look you wear in Trillion.
